prayerExcerpt.en-US: We admire the great actions and the glorious triumph of the Saints; yet it is not so much in these that their sanctity consisted, as in the constant, habitual heroic disposition of their souls.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Admiramos as grandes ações e o glorioso triunfo dos Santos; contudo não foi tanto nestes que consistiu sua santidade, quanto na constante, habitual e heroica disposição de suas almas.

meta.face: A Syrian of Antioch of about sixty-five with a warm olive complexion and an OBLONG face under a HIGH, BALD, DOMED forehead — a LONG, fine, straight nose, NARROW-SET dark eyes under STRAIGHT, HEAVY black-and-grey brows that nearly meet, FLAT cheeks, a small, firm mouth; short grey hair at the sides and back; a FULL, ROUNDED grey beard of medium length, as in the Menologion; the gaze direct and thoughtful. Not the hair-hidden, high-bridged cyril_alexandria, the egg-headed, long-black-bearded anicetus, or the broad-browed, short-faced lucian_antioch.
meta.basis: The Menologion of Basil II (c. 1000) shows him as a bishop in phelonion and omophorion with grey hair and a rounded grey beard, holding the Gospels; the card follows its dress and beard. The book makes him a Syrian monk and priest of Antioch, and Wikipedia an abbot there; the bald dome and brows are ours.
